text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service on Wednesday said it confirmed the debt ratings of Quebec-Telephone with mostly negative trends.

The rating agency confirmed the company's first mortgage bonds at A (low) with a stable trend. Quebec-Telephone's unsecured debentures were confirmed at A (low), preferred shares at Pfd-2 and commercial paper at R-1 (low), all with negative trends.
DBRS said the rating confirmations reflect the company's relatively strong balance sheet and coverage ratios, and its network system which is 100 percent digital.

The agency said the negative trends on most of the company's issues recognize that deregulation is leading to increased competition in the long-distance business which will hurt the company's earnings and may cause coverage ratios to weaken from current levels.
The negative trends also recognize that debt levels may increase modestly over the next few years, as Quebec Telephone accelerates a network expansion and modernization program, DBRS said.
